_note: Selectors the reference style has that this style deliberately does not need. Each one was checked by eye. tools/check_style.py skips them, so anything it still prints is a NEW gap.

reviewed.[data-pos=\"right\"])[data-size=\"sm\"]: hint: the pointer is already small here; no separate side+sm size needed
reviewed.[data-variant=\"glossy\"])[data-shape=\": icon-button: round is handled once for every variant via --r:50%
icon-button: no glossy face layer in this style
icon-button: no shine dot in this style
reviewed..sc-popup-header:has(.sc-popup-sub) + .s: popup: the subtitle sits inline under the title, not as a hanging tag, so the body needs no extra top padding
reviewed..sc-progress:has(> img[data-sc-icon]) .s: progress: the icon sits beside the bar, not overlapping it, so the label stays centred
reviewed..sc-slider:focus-visible .sc-slider-thum: slider: focus ring is drawn on the track instead of the sheared thumb
reviewed..sc-tabbar-item[aria-selected=\"true\"]: tabbar: the selected item does not lift in this style, so the badge does not move
reviewed..sc-timer[data-variant=\"pill\"].sc-warn: timer: the general .sc-warn text rule already covers the pill
